raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

`DFLASH` is rejected when DCP and HiCache are enabled, even though the existing replicated draft sidecar mirrors the widened logical slot space. Removing that guard alone also leaves automatic host sizing undercounting the draft allocation, and Mooncake's object-layout handshake can assert because it inspects a physical page instead of a logical storage page.

## Modifications

- Admit DFlash alongside DSpark through the existing DCP/HiCache path, preserving the unsupported-mode guards.
- Account for DCP-widened full draft sidecars in automatic host-cache sizing; keep SWA slot accounting unchanged.
- Use the logical page span for Mooncake object-layout inspection.
- Update the Kimi-K3/HiCache documentation. No kernel or speculative verification algorithm changes.

This PR contains no test-file changes. The validation below was run locally against the same runtime code.

## Accuracy Tests

Manual validation on 8 GB300 GPUs across two four-GPU nodes, based on `5cc9c933fc8acdffb5fc847d3b4824f082cd3297`:

- Target: `moonshotai/Kimi-K3`; draft: `modal-labs/Kimi-K3-DFlash@c192d15a43407bf758b5ae0880d5c72052fef1de`, block size 2.
- BF16 target/draft KV, FP32 SSM, TP8/DCP8, overlap and decode graphs enabled. Natural acceptance, without acceptance simulation.
- Frozen inputs of 2,100/4,700/8,800 tokens, 256 generated tokens. Restored/reference acceptance ratio must be at least 0.9; decode-versus-fresh-prefill logprob maximum difference must remain below 0.5.

| Check | Result |
| --- | --- |
| DFlash L2 eviction/load-back | 3/3 passed; host reuse 2048/4608/8704, device reuse zero |
| Native Mooncake TCP L3 | 6/6 passed across fresh-engine and flush/overwrite/restore cycles |
| File L3 | 6/6 passed across the same restore cycles |
| DCP1 DFlash regression | Base and candidate each passed 3/3, with identical judged values |
| DSpark DCP8 Mooncake regression | 6/6 passed |

The DFlash restores preserved acceptance (ratio 1.0) with maximum numerical difference 0.260715. Per-rank target/draft keys, payload sizes and Mamba state objects were checked after the judged requests. A disposable negative control suppressing only draft-sidecar preservation still restored target state but reduced acceptance ratios to 0.514/0.502/0.64, so the acceptance check detects draft-state loss hidden by target verification.

Mooncake validation used the real native TCP service with external 8 GiB segments per node, engine global segment zero and no SSD offload. Focused suites passed 115 CPU cases and 1,857 CUDA cache-component cases; 301 explicit fixture-matrix cases were skipped. Local negative-control probes also provide causal failing-base/passing-candidate evidence.

An FP8 KV baseline control exceeded the fixed numerical tolerance (0.777606 versus 0.5). These results validate the BF16 KV configuration; this PR does not claim to resolve that FP8 numerical gap or validate a separate `DFlash2DraftModel` selector checkpoint.

Publication checks: the remaining runtime and documentation files passed the applicable pre-commit hooks. A fail-fast full-repository run stops at an unchanged baseline F821 (`MLATokenToKVPool` in `python/sglang/srt/managers/cache_controller.py:885`), reproduced directly on the validation base. CI-pinned Mintlify 4.2.559 `broken-links --check-anchors --check-redirects` also passes.

GSM8K follow-up: preparing a matched 200-example FP8-target-KV accuracy check with actual Mooncake L3 reuse. No GSM8K score is reported yet.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

No throughput or latency improvement is claimed. RDMA, SSD offload and production-load performance were not validated.

## Checklist

- [x] Run pre-commit on changed files; repository-wide baseline blocker documented above.
- [x] Run focused local regressions; no test-file changes are included.
- [x] Update documentation.
- [x] Provide the functional and numerical results above; no speed claim.
- [x] Follow the existing cache/sidecar mechanisms and code style.

 ### 3.3 HiCache (Hierarchical KV Caching)
 
-K3's hybrid HiCache tiers the paged MLA KV **and** the KDA/mamba state across L1 (GPU) / L2 (host) / L3 (Mooncake) — enable it from the **HiCache** card in the [Playground above](#playground) for long multi-turn workloads.
+K3's hybrid HiCache tiers the paged MLA KV **and** the KDA/mamba state across L1 (GPU) / L2 (host) / L3 (Mooncake or file) — enable it from the **HiCache** card in the [Playground above](#playground) for long multi-turn workloads.
 
-- On the DCP recipes (Blackwell Balanced / High-Throughput, `Unified` and `Decode` roles), **L1+L2 keeps DCP**, with Spec Decode off or on DSPARK. On B200 the DSPARK pipeline collapse scales it too (PP2 × DCPEP8 → DCPEP16).
-- **L3 drops the DCP flags** on those recipes (storage keys are not dcp_rank-aware yet; the command hints call it out, and per-request KV capacity shrinks). Only DCP goes: the MLA KV reverts to TP-replicated while the cell's other parallelism stays, so B300/GB300/GB200 land on plain TP and B200 Unified keeps its `--pp-size 2` / `--ep-size`.
+- **DCP**: SGLang keeps DCP at every tier (L1+L2, and L3 on Mooncake or file) with Spec Decode off, DSPARK, or DFLASH. On B200 the DSPARK pipeline collapse scales it too (PP2 × DCPEP8 → DCPEP16). DCP shards only the target MLA KV. The draft KV is not DCP-sharded; HiCache mirrors it into a separate host draft pool that `--hicache-size` does not include.
+- **Tested with DCP**: TP8/DCP8 on GB300 2×4 with DFLASH using the original [`modal-labs/Kimi-K3-DFlash`](https://huggingface.co/modal-labs/Kimi-K3-DFlash) draft (`DFlashDraftModel`) at `--speculative-dflash-block-size 2`, across L1+L2 and L3 on both Mooncake (TCP) and file. This ran as a numerical control with `--kv-cache-dtype bf16`, `--speculative-draft-kv-cache-dtype bf16`, `--mamba-ssm-dtype float32`, and `--mamba-radix-cache-strategy extra_buffer`; the fp8 recipes and the block size 8 default above are unchanged.
+- **Playground commands**: the Playground presets keep their non-DCP layout for DFLASH + HiCache and for L3, so on the DCP recipes they drop the DCP flags. Only DCP goes: the MLA KV reverts to TP-replicated while the cell's other parallelism stays, so B300/GB300/GB200 land on plain TP, B200 Unified keeps its `--pp-size 2` / `--ep-size`, and per-request KV capacity shrinks. To run the tested layout, keep `--dcp-size` in the command.
+- **L2 sizing**: `--hicache-size` is in decimal GB per rank and splits between the MLA KV and the KDA state in proportion to their GPU pools. With `extra_buffer`, each prefill chunk leaves its own KDA checkpoint, so a 32K-token prompt at `--chunked-prefill-size 8192` holds four host state slots, not one.
+- **File L3**: `--hicache-storage-backend file` writes to `SGLANG_HICACHE_FILE_BACKEND_STORAGE_DIR`. Only TP rank 0 creates that directory, so on multi-node runs with node-local disks, create it on every node before launch.
 - Low-Latency and the Hopper recipes take all tiers unchanged.
